faq.domanda: How much does it cost to decorate a shop window in Locarno?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the window, the type of graphic and the materials chosen. A small piece of lettering or a logo on the entrance door is fairly inexpensive, while a full window with decorative films calls for a larger investment. We prepare a free, tailored quote within 24/48h after a site visit or once we have your window measurements.

faq.domanda: Do you also work in Muralto, Ascona and the other towns in the Locarno area?
faq.risposta: Yes, we work in Locarno and throughout the Locarno area, from Muralto to Ascona and as far as the Terre di Pedemonte and the Vallemaggia. We come to your premises for the site visit and the installation wherever you are in Ticino.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to install the decoration?
faq.risposta: The application usually takes four to five hours, but timing varies depending on the complexity of the design and the surface to be covered. We arrange the work at convenient times, even before opening, so we don't interrupt your business during peak hours.

faq.domanda: Can you work without closing the business during the tourist season?
faq.risposta: Yes. We schedule the installation during quieter times, for example early in the morning or at the start of the week, so your business stays open even in the busiest periods such as summer.

faq.domanda: Can I decorate just part of the window, like the logo or the opening hours?
faq.risposta: Of course. You can choose to apply just the logo, the business name, the opening hours or a promotional message, leaving the rest of the glass clear. It's a discreet solution that is very popular with bars, offices and boutiques in every area.

faq.domanda: Do the films withstand strong sun and the lake climate?
faq.risposta: Yes. We use professional materials resistant to UV rays, humidity and the temperature swings typical of the mild Lake Maggiore climate, so the decoration doesn't fade and keeps a well-kept look for years.

faq.domanda: Can window films also screen the view from outside?
faq.risposta: Yes. As well as decorative graphics, we make frosted and sandblasted-effect films that provide privacy and filter the light, useful for offices, studios and restaurants that face very busy streets.

faq.domanda: Is it possible to remove or change the decoration in the future?
faq.risposta: Yes. The applied films can be removed without damaging the glass, so you can update the graphics for a new season, a logo change or a promotion with no trouble.
